newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-PetSec has gas shows at U.S. wells.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-PetSec has gas shows at U.S. wells.

text.p: Oil and gas explorer Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd said on Thursday it had three gas shows at new exploration wells in the United States.

"Three gas shows have been recorded on the mud log in the West Cameron 461 No 1 well, which is currently drilling ahead at 2,772 metres toward primary target zones," the company said in its weekly drilling report.
Petroleum Securities said it would evaluate the commercial significance of these gas shows on electric logs to be run when the well reaches total depth.

The company also said production commenced January 28 at the West Cameron 544 A-8 oil and gas discovery well and was flowing at a restricted clean-up rate of 6.5 million cubic feet of gas a day and 74 barrels of oil a day.
The Ship Shoal 193 No 3 oil discovery well was resuming completion operations which had been delayed by weather.
The South Marsh Island 7 No 1 exploration well located in the Gulf of Mexico was drilling ahead at a depth of 3,652 metres (11,982 feet), the company said.
Two gas shows have been recorded on the mud log over the gross measured depth intervals 3,472 to 3,484 metres(11,390 to 11,430) and 3,587 to 3,587 metres (11,761 to 11,767 feet).
The shows were from above the primary targets in the well and their commercial significance will be evaluated on electric logs to be run at the next casing point depth, PetSec said.
